keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Mihail Gherasimencov (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Dawid Bugaj (CF Montréal).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Édier Ocampo (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Victor Loturi (CF Montréal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, CF Montréal. Noah Streit replaces Hennadii Synchuk.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Bruno Caicedo replaces Yadaly Diaby.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Rui Modesto replaces Édier Ocampo.
Second Half begins CF Montréal 0, Vancouver Whitecaps FC 0.
Goal! CF Montréal 0, Vancouver Whitecaps FC 1. Cheikh Sabaly (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the top right corner.
Ralph Priso (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Thomas Müller replaces Ryan Gauld.
Substitution, CF Montréal. Fabian Herbers replaces Olger Escobar.
Substitution, CF Montréal. Alexis Sánchez replaces Daniel Ríos.
Substitution, CF Montréal. Brayan Ceballos replaces Dawid Bugaj.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Tristan Blackmon replaces Ralph Priso.
Luca Petrasso (CF Montréal) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! CF Montréal 0, Vancouver Whitecaps FC 2. Mihail Gherasimencov (Vancouver Whitecaps FC) left footed shot from a difficult angle on the left to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Bruno Caicedo.
Substitution, Vancouver Whitecaps FC. Sebastián Ramírez replaces Oliver Larraz.
Second Half ends, CF Montréal 0, Vancouver Whitecaps FC 2.
